After the event Apprentice P N Wong stated that her instructions were to take up a forward position.  Trainer K H Ting confirmed the instructions issued.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

No report.

Near the 700 Metres COOL BLUE and TEAM HAPPY shifted ground and bumped, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.  After the event M Chadwick reported that, in his view, COOL BLUE is better suited on the turf.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 700 Metres got unbalanced after bumping with COOL BLUE.  Approaching the winning post was placed in restricted room between MR ALADDIN and ALL EYES ON ME which shifted out slightly.  After the event K Teetan reported that his instructions were to take up a forward position off the speed and at the same time gain some cover.  He added that for him to carry out those instructions he ended up behind GO GO GO which was unable to continue with a forward position into the race and therefore he was obliged to settle further back in the field than he would have liked.

After the event Apprentice E C W Wong could offer no explanation for his mount’s performance other than it was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  The performance of SPORTIC WARRIOR, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SPORTIC WARRIOR will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.   A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

After the event Z Purton explained that he was required to retire his mount out of the race in the Home Straight when it failed to respond to his riding rounding the Home Turn.  He added that, in his opinion, the horse did not feel comfortable in its action.  Trainer K L Man stated that SPANGLE FORTUNE had worked well leading up to the event and Jockey Purton reported to him that the horse resented the kickback on the All Weather surface.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, SPANGLE FORTUNE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  When questioned H Bowman explained that after leaving the 500 Metres he was unable to improve his position when following ONLY U and eventually was able to obtain clear running to that horse’s outside after passing the 300 Metres as he felt the alternative option to go to the inside of ONLY U would have been detrimental to his mount’s chances. H Bowman was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 200 Metres and again near the 150 Metres (4 in total).
Jumped only fairly and then was inconvenienced by BRAVE OF FRIENDS which was taken in slightly by KA YING POWER.

After passing the 400 Metres had some difficulty obtaining clear running between CIRCUIT FIERY and DECRELOT.  It was noted that over the final 200 Metres B Avdulla refrained from using his whip on the horse which was in accordance with his instructions.  Trainer J Size confirmed the instructions issued.
No report.
No report.
A short distance after the start became unbalanced after being bumped by MACANESE MASTER which shifted in.
Slow to begin.
No report.

No report.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse had returned an abnormal heart rate requiring further assessment.  Following further assessment of the abnormal heart rate, the Stewards will consider if any further action is taken against the horse. <8/10/2025  4 October 2025 Sha Tin Racemeeting – Race 2 (67)> Confirmed on specialist advice to be displaying an irregular heart rhythm after the race. Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY GENERATIONS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

After the event M Chadwick reported that his instructions were to take up a more forward position, however, from a wide barrier he made the decision to press on in order to avoid covering extra ground.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.

After passing the 500 Metres was steadied away from the heels of LUCK IS BACK.  After the race an endoscopic examination was conducted on RELIABLE PROFIT at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed that the horse was displaying an epiglottic entrapment.
No report.
No report.

No report.

Became fractious and reared after being placed in the starting gates.  Was removed from the barriers, examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Before being allowed to race again, VIEW ALL THINGS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a small abrasion to the right front leg and also to be displaying an airway abnormality pending further assessment. <19/10/2025 4 October 2025 Sha Tin Racemeeting– Race 3 (68)> A further assessment of VIEW ALL THINGS confirmed that the horse was found to be a "roarer”.

Jumped awkwardly and then got unbalanced after being bumped by CELTIC TIMES which shifted out.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse had returned an abnormal heart rate requiring further assessment.  Following further assessment of the abnormal heart rate, the Stewards will consider if any further action is taken against the horse.  Sent for sampling post-race. <30/10/2025 4 October 2025 Sha Tin Racemeeting– Race 3 (68)> A further assessment of the abnormal heart rate did not reveal any significant findings.
Shifted out shortly after the start and bumped FIGHTING MACHINE.

Jumped awkwardly and then a short distance later was checked when tightened for room between SIGHT SUPREME which shifted in and YIU CHEUNG VICTORY which shifted out when taken out slightly by BILLION TWO.
No report.

After the event Apprentice E C W Wong reported that he was instructed to take up a forward position but from the outside barrier he was unable to carry out his instructions and was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of CHARMING STEED, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, CHARMING STEED will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

The performance of BILLION TWO, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, BILLION TWO will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.   A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 400 Metres became awkwardly placed on the heels of PATCH OF WATCH after making contact with SHINYU KOKOROE when endeavouring to shift out to obtain clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Slow to begin.  When questioned regarding his riding tactics in the early part of the Home Straight, particularly between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres J Orman explained that at that time he was weighing up his options as to what run to take when held up behind STRATHPEFFER.  He added that STRATHPEFFER commenced to shift out near the 300 Metres which allowed him to then improve to the inside of STRATHPEFFER and put his mount under his normal vigorous riding.  Sent for sampling post-race.

At declaration time, L Ferraris was declared as the rider of both AUDACIOUS PURSUIT and NEWBORN MIRACLE.  It was established that L Ferraris had a firm commitment to ride AUDACIOUS PURSUIT.  As such, the Stewards permitted A Atzeni to be substituted as the rider of NEWBORN MIRACLE.  For this declaration error, Jockey Ferraris was fined $2,000.  Jumped a little awkwardly.  After leaving the 500 Metres was unable to improve its position before shifting out approaching the 350 Metres to obtain clear running and forced SMILING FALCON a little wider.  Approaching the 200 Metres was bumped by ROMAN CROWN which shifted out.

When questioned regarding his riding tactics in the Home Straight, particularly from the 500 Metres to near the 300 Metres C L Chau explained that he was mindful that the horse was weighted with 133 lbs today, being first up from a spell and was obliged to race extremely wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  He added for this reason he was reluctant to put his mount under too much pressure in the early part of the Home Straight with a view to assisting it to finish the race off.  He said, in his opinion, FUN TOGETHER would derive benefit from its first up run today.
No report.

Jumped awkwardly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  After passing the 300 Metres was held up behind FUN TOGETHER before shifting out approaching the 200 Metres to obtain clear running and in doing so bumped AUDACIOUS PURSUIT.
No report.

After leaving the 400 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running until near the 200 Metres.
After the event D Probert explained that his instructions were to be positive on the horse.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SMILING FALCON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of LAHORE was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race start.  Before being allowed to race again, LAHORE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  After the event M L Yeung reported that he had some concerns with his mount’s action in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

The start was delayed when FORTUNE KINGO proved very difficult to load into the barriers.  After the event H Bentley reported that his mount raced quite intractably.  The barrier manners and racing manners of FORTUNE KINGO were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FORTUNE KINGO will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

When questioned regarding her riding tactics leaving the 700 Metres when commencing a run three wide at that point with the first section of the race being run inside standard Apprentice P N Wong conceded that in hindsight she had erred by commencing a run too soon and that she should have waited longer before sustaining a run so far from the finish.  The Stewards informed Apprentice Wong that she had erred on this occasion and should be mindful to ensure that her mounts are ridden in a manner that gain the best possible placing in the finish.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Proved difficult to proceed to the Start.  A warning was placed on the horse regarding its pre-race parade manners.

L Hewitson (METRO POWER) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that after passing the 500 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out leaving insufficient room for PACKING BOLE and FAST RESPONDER which were racing to his outside, resulting in FAST RESPONDER being checked and losing its rightful running.  L Hewitson was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Sunday, 26 October 2025 at Sha Tin.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very good race riding record.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Withdrawn by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice after it was found to be displaying an abnormal heart rate during the pre-race examination which required further assessment.  Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY INFINITY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Following further assessment of the abnormal heart rate, the Stewards will consider if any further action is taken against the horse. <19/10/2025 4 October 2025 Sha Tin Racemeeting– Race 9 (74)> Confirmed on specialist advice to be displaying an irregular heart rhythm after the pre-race veterinary examination. Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY INFINITY will now be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and also be subjected to an official veterinary examination as previously advised.
